name: PhotoCraft
tagline: Image editing: layers, masks, type and real PSD files.
description: PhotoCraft is an open-source photo editor written from scratch in pure Rust by the ArtCraft team — layers, masks, type and support for real PSD files. It ships as a native universal macOS app (DMG and Homebrew cask) and also runs on Windows and Linux. Like all Crafting Apps it is young and moving fast: v0.11.1 landed in October 2026.

zh.tagline: 图像编辑：图层、蒙版、文字与原生 PSD 支持。
zh.description: PhotoCraft 是 ArtCraft 团队从零开始、用纯 Rust 编写的开源照片编辑器——支持图层、蒙版、文字与真实 PSD 文件。提供 macOS universal 原生版本（DMG 与 Homebrew cask），同时支持 Windows 和 Linux。和所有 Crafting Apps 一样年轻而迭代飞快：v0.11.1 于 2026 年 10 月发布。

body.en: PhotoCraft is the ArtCraft family's open-source photo editor, written from scratch in pure Rust. It focuses on everyday image editing — layers, masks, type — and opens real PSD files.
body.zh: PhotoCraft 是 ArtCraft 家族的开源照片编辑器，从零开始用纯 Rust 编写，聚焦日常图像编辑的核心：图层、蒙版、文字，并且能打开真实的 PSD 文件。

body.en: It ships as a native universal macOS app (DMG and Homebrew cask) alongside Windows and Linux builds. Development moves fast — v0.11.1 landed in October 2026.
body.zh: macOS 提供 universal 原生版本（DMG 与 Homebrew cask），同时有 Windows 和 Linux 构建。迭代很快——v0.11.1 于 2026 年 10 月发布。
